steps.title: Manual Offset Management
steps.text: Disable auto-commit to control exactly when offsets are committed. Choose at-most-once (commit before processing), at-least-once (commit after), or exactly-once (transactional).

steps.title: Seek Operations
steps.text: Navigate to specific offsets, timestamps, or partition boundaries. Seek to beginning to reprocess all messages, seek to end to skip to latest, or seek to a specific offset.

steps.title: Pause and Resume
steps.text: Pause specific partitions for backpressure handling, priority processing, resource management, or error recovery. Resume them when ready to continue processing.

steps.title: Delivery Guarantees
steps.text: At-most-once may lose messages but never duplicates. At-least-once never loses but may reprocess. Exactly-once guarantees both but with higher latency.

steps.title: Consumer Architecture
steps.text: Advanced consumers combine offset managers, flow controllers, and checkpoint stores to provide fine-grained control over message processing and partition assignment.
